baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction جَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالًا joins causative making to a beneficiary dative.
baseline_models.mechanism: The state-making branch of ج ع ل and the wealth branch's inclusion of causing another to have property make the clause an installation of economic status, not only movement of an object.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state makes جَعَلْتُ the act that installs the beneficiary's new condition.
Acquiring and having wealth supplies the economic condition conferred on him.
Lengthwise extension gives the conferred estate reach beyond a punctual transfer.

changed_reading.before: I gave him a large amount of wealth.
changed_reading.after: I caused an extended condition of wealth to stand for him, making him into a wealthy beneficiary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjective مَمْدُودًا directly qualifies مَالًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The connected-increase branch of م د د makes the property function like a supply line whose added material reinforces its recipient, rather than a closed pile measured only by size.

activation_trace.role: Property and abundance provide the material stock that can be supplied.
Connected increase that sustains another turns the adjective into an ongoing reinforcement mechanism.

changed_reading.after: The wealth was an attached stream of increase that kept materially reinforcing its beneficiary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive adjective مَمْدُودًا can project extension across the beneficiary's possession of مَالًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The term-or-respite branch of م د د permits a temporal reading: what is extended is not only the estate's span or amount, but the time during which the beneficiary enjoys it.

activation_trace.role: Possessed wealth supplies the benefit whose tenure can last.
An extended term or respite makes duration a live axis of مَمْدُودًا.

changed_reading.before: The adjective says that the wealth was vast.
changed_reading.after: The adjective may say that possession and enjoyment of the wealth were prolonged as a term of respite.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالًا can formally be heard as assigning wealth to someone.
baseline_models.mechanism: The stipulated-reward branch of ج ع ل activates a wage-like possibility in which the assigned wealth is consideration for an undertaking, although the focus clause names no task and leaves the relation underspecified.

activation_trace.role: A reward stipulated for work makes assignment of consideration a form-distant but grammatically anchored possibility.
Wealth supplies the possible consideration assigned to the beneficiary.

changed_reading.before: The wealth is an unqualified gift.
changed_reading.after: At focus-only resolution, the wealth can weakly resemble assigned consideration, though no work is stated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier prohibition places cutting-off extension, release without compensation, and seeking numerical growth in one construction. Against it, مَالًا مَمْدُودًا reads as an uncut gratuitous flow, while a wage-like or return-seeking reading loses force.

activation_trace.role: Continuous extension supplies the positive pole opposed by interruption.
Stipulated consideration supplies the transactional baseline that the context weakens.
Cutting and diminishing until extension ceases forms a direct negative counterpart to مَمْدُودًا.
Release without compensation makes gratuitous giving the alternative to a wage or exchange.
Numerical abundance and growth identify the return that must not govern the act of giving.

structural_cues: 74:6 precedes the focus and joins the giving verb to تَسْتَكْثِرُ under negation.
The focus later presents a first-person benefactor and a third-person beneficiary without naming reciprocal work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an interruption-versus-extension opposition and a no-compensation branch; I carry that opposition from the earlier command into the focus grant. The live alternative is that 74:6 addresses a different agent and supplies no rule for the later endowment.

changed_reading.before: The wealth could be mere quantity or even assigned consideration.
changed_reading.after: It reads more sharply as a benefit released without return and left uncut in its extension; seeking gain belongs to the recipient-side distortion, not the grant's logic.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence first brings the person into being in aloneness, then makes extended wealth for him. The focus therefore marks a manufactured transition from bare creaturehood to endowed economic status and denies the wealth any self-origin.

activation_trace.role: State-making makes the focus the transition point into endowed status.
Having wealth names the acquired condition on the far side of that transition.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the beneficiary's prior origin from the same first-person speaker.
Separation and singularity supply the unaccompanied starting state that the wealth then changes.

structural_cues: 74:11 and 74:12 share a first-person singular actor and the same third-person object or beneficiary.
The focus follows وَحِيدًا immediately, so the wealth occupies the first added layer in the enumeration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation, aloneness, and then endowed wealth; I read وَحِيدًا as a baseline without the enumerated adjuncts and make the focus the transition. It could instead describe personal singularity without implying prior material lack.

changed_reading.before: A man already in view receives a large estate.
changed_reading.after: The one created alone is deliberately converted into a wealthy beneficiary, so every extension of the estate remains derivative rather than self-made.

context_deltas.mechanism: Present sons and thoroughly prepared conditions follow the extended wealth as mutually reinforcing supports. The extension now has social and environmental reach: estate, lineage, witnesses, and a leveled field together hold up the beneficiary's position.

activation_trace.role: The property is the material component of the support architecture.
Connected increase that reinforces another supplies the architecture's linking function.
Filiation and lineage extend the beneficiary's support through descendants.
Presence with witnessing makes the sons available social support rather than absent lineage.
Preparing and leveling an affair turns the surrounding conditions into a deliberately furnished field.

structural_cues: 74:12-14 are one first-person enumeration linked by waw, with لَهُ recurring in 74:12 and 74:14.
74:14 intensifies preparation through a verb plus cognate accusative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent wealth, present sons, and thorough preparation; I treat them as coordinated supports and let the sons instantiate the focus adjective's connected extension. They may instead be three independent favors with no network relation.

changed_reading.before: Extended wealth is a large or continuing material stock.
changed_reading.after: It is the material strand of a deliberately built support system that extends through present lineage and prepared circumstances.

context_deltas.mechanism: The beneficiary converts prolonged, connected supply into hope for further increase; the ensuing refusal reverses that imagined trajectory into an imposed arduous ascent. Extension is therefore a temporary runway that can change direction, not a guarantee of endless escalation.

activation_trace.role: Extended time or respite supplies the duration that the beneficiary mistakes for a continuing guarantee.
Connected increase supplies the forward material trajectory expected to continue.
The heart's hope turns experienced extension into an expectation.
Increase and growth name the upward continuation sought from the giver.
Imposition of a heavy burden reverses reinforcing supply into oppressive demand.
An arduous uphill obstacle gives the reversal a spatially rising but adverse direction.

structural_cues: 74:15 follows the three-item endowment list with ثُمَّ and asks for increase from the same first-person speaker.
74:16's كَلَّا blocks the desired continuation before 74:17 announces the burden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies endowment, subsequent hope for increase, refusal, and uphill burden; I infer that the prior supply trained or licensed the expectation and that the burden reverses its trajectory. Greed could predate the gift, and the ascent may punish resistance rather than reverse wealth specifically.

changed_reading.before: The extended wealth denotes a stable long-running benefit.
changed_reading.after: It denotes a provisional trajectory misread as guaranteed growth; the giver can terminate and invert that trajectory into arduous burden.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later repeated acts of ج ع ل configure agents and a count, with the count explicitly functioning as a test. That reuse of the focus predicate retroactively activates the wealth as another deliberately assigned condition that may test rather than merely reward its recipient.

activation_trace.role: State-making makes wealth a configured condition whose function can exceed benefaction.
The possession of wealth is the condition potentially carrying the test.
Two later acts of making assign natures and roles, establishing deliberate configuration as a repeated pattern.
Testing metal or a person supplies an evaluative purpose for one explicitly assigned condition.

structural_cues: 74:31 repeats جَعَلْنَا twice and explicitly predicates فِتْنَةً of the second assigned object.
The focus and 74:31 share a divine first-person making predicate, though their objects differ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly makes the later count a test; I analogically carry that functional possibility back through the repeated predicate to the wealth. The materially live alternative is that trial-purpose belongs only to the count and cannot be generalized to earlier gifts.

changed_reading.before: Making wealth for him is straightforward favor.
changed_reading.after: Making wealth for him may also be deliberate placement in a test-bearing state, with abundance serving exposure as well as advantage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later economic and legal images distinguish divinely supplied wealth from human earning, hold the self as security for what it acquires, and name failure to pass sustenance to the deprived within a scene of account. The extended supply becomes accountable capital whose circulation matters.

activation_trace.role: Possessed property supplies the resource later placed under economic accountability.
Supply that sustains another establishes circulation as the focus wealth's latent function.
Seeking and obtaining livelihood marks the human acquisition side, distinct from the focus speaker's prior grant.
Security held against a right turns acquisition into an obligation-bearing legal relation.
Feeding another supplies the concrete outward transfer that the speakers confess they withheld.
The abasement of poverty identifies the deprived endpoint from which material support was withheld.
Account and recompense place the failed transfer inside a final settlement.
Financial debt supplies a cross-branch legal analogy for wealth that carries an outstanding claim.

structural_cues: 74:38 states a universal earning-and-collateral rule before 74:44's plural confession of not feeding the poor.
74:46 locates the confession under يَوْمِ الدِّينِ, while the focus grant came from a different singular speaker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grant, earning, collateral, withheld feeding, poverty, and account; I infer that supplied wealth bears a duty to circulate and call it accountable capital. The shift from the singled-out beneficiary to plural speakers means this is an ethical carryback, not proof that 74:44 narrates his individual act.

changed_reading.before: The extended wealth is private advantage possessed by its beneficiary.
changed_reading.after: It is incoming supply that enters an account through its use: failure to extend sustenance onward converts possession into an outstanding claim against the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: One later root inventory holds both turning one's side away and worldly goods or a share of this world. That internal branch crossing makes extended wealth a possible material axis of the later aversion: accumulation can orient its holder away from reminder.

activation_trace.role: Possessed wealth supplies the worldly stock capable of governing orientation.
Drawn-out extension magnifies the worldly stock's reach.
Turning one's side away supplies the actual posture toward the reminder.
Worldly goods or a worldly share supplies a same-root material image for what may drive that posture.

structural_cues: 74:49 asks about a sustained orientation away from التَّذْكِرَةِ.
The surface participle selects the turning-away branch; the worldly-goods image is a separate branch in the same packet inventory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two branches but no causal arrow; I propose that worldly stock can produce or embody the turning orientation and carry that possibility back to مَالًا. The live alternative is ordinary polysemy with no intended interaction between the branches.

changed_reading.before: The wealth is an external benefit that precedes later rejection.
changed_reading.after: Its very worldly extension can become an orientation mechanism, furnishing the material direction in which the beneficiary turns away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a remote branch of the opening title across different human subjects. It remains packet-anchored because that branch literally names accumulated wealth while the focus names wealth and extension; downstream prose should present it only as an opening-frame resonance, not as the lexical meaning of مَمْدُودًا or an identification of the two subjects.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَالًا مَمْدُودًا names wealth whose extension can be imagined as accumulated layers around its holder.

activation_trace.role: Having abundant property supplies the material that accumulates around the beneficiary.
Lengthwise extension lets the accumulation become layered and enclosing rather than merely numerous.
Abundant accumulated wealth directly echoes the focus material through the opening root's unexpected branch.
An outer covering converts accumulation into an enclosing image around the wealth-holder.

changed_reading.before: The beneficiary has wealth extended outward in amount or duration.
changed_reading.after: The extended wealth can be pictured as an accumulated outer covering that surrounds, shelters, and potentially obscures its holder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because it activates the inkwell branch of م د د for an adjective of wealth and joins it to much later sheets. It remains anchored in the packet's replenishing-ink image, the focus wealth, and the written and spread-sheet branches; downstream prose must call it an inscriptional material analogy, not a gloss or a claim that the wealth literally consists of writing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjective مَمْدُودًا carries an inventory branch in which one reservoir continually supplies writing material to another instrument.

activation_trace.role: Wealth supplies the material provision recast through an inscriptional analogy.
An inkwell supplying a pen makes extension a replenishing reservoir that enables inscription.
A written sheet supplies the later object onto which entitlement is imagined as personally legible.
Opening, spreading, and branching gives the sheets a physical extension parallel to the focus adjective.
Writing or a published document makes the later demand explicitly inscriptional.

changed_reading.before: Extended wealth is a replenished material resource.
changed_reading.after: As an analogy, it becomes the reservoir from which a beneficiary imagines a personally spread and written entitlement should keep being inscribed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet-authorized non-dominant ر ب و target resolved under the context root ر ب ب and applies its transactional-increase image across verses. It remains valid as a split-root activation anchored by مَالًا, the connected-increase branch of مَمْدُودًا, and explicit later increase; downstream prose must label it lexical resonance and must not claim that رَبّ in 74:3 means usury.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَالًا مَمْدُودًا can support an accrual model because its noun is property and its adjective has a connected-increase branch.

activation_trace.role: Property supplies the principal-like stock on which increase can accrue.
Connected increase that supplies another gives the stock a self-continuing accrual image.
Transactional riba-increase supplies the non-dominant split-root image of increment attaching to wealth.
Explicit increase and growth confirm that further increment is the beneficiary's desired trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The wealth is a static large estate.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, it resembles principal extended by accrual, generating the expectation that increment will keep attaching to it.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from static quantity to a status-conferring, connected supply.
The immediate sequence made the wealth a hinge between created aloneness and a furnished social-material support system.
The request for increase and the imposed ascent turned extension from guaranteed continuity into a reversible respite.
Later earning, collateral, feeding, poverty, and account made supplied wealth answerable for whether support travels onward.
summary.what_was_special: The sharpest latent activation was the packet's direct opposition between م ن ن as cutting until extension ceases and focus م د د as extension, reinforced by the created-alone/endowed/prepared sequence. Same-root branch crossings and a non-dominant mapped target also preserved stranger material and financial readings without allowing them to become primary glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: The spatial, supply-line, and temporal branches of م د د remain co-present; the focus alone does not select only one axis.
The trial reading analogically carries a function from 74:31 back to wealth even though only the later count is explicitly called a test.
The accountability model crosses from one singled-out beneficiary to later plural confessions and therefore establishes a surah-level mechanism rather than individual identity.
The covering, inscriptional, and split-root accrual outliers are deliberately form-distant and should remain visibly qualified.
